name: Aikar G1GC 预设
author: AC
description: 服务器常用的 Aikar 参数组合（G1GC 分代回收），适合 4GB+ 内存环境。
description_en: Aikar's widely-used server flags built on G1GC, best for 4GB+ RAM setups.

name: 午夜
author: AC
description: 深紫暗色主题，冷调底色配紫罗兰强调，适合夜间久坐。
description_en: Dark violet theme with a violet accent, easy on the eyes at night.

name: 崩溃后自动重启
author: AC
description: 发现崩溃后优先建议重启游戏并自动做崩溃分析。
description_en: After a crash, favor restarting and analyze the report automatically.

name: 毛玻璃
author: AC
description: 把卡片与弹窗换成半透明的玻璃拟态质感，浅色/暗色主题都更通透。
description_en: Turns cards and dialogs into a translucent frosted-glass look for both light and dark themes.

name: 透底窗口
author: AC
description: 启用系统级亚克力半透明窗口，桌面背景透出来，边缘更柔和。（仅 Windows 10 1803+）
description_en: Enables the system Acrylic translucent window so the desktop shows through. (Windows 10 1803+ only)

name: 液态流光
author: AC
description: 列表卡片与商店卡的流光描边与反射扫光动画。
description_en: Animated light-trail borders and reflective sweeps on list and store cards.

name: 页面切换动画
author: AC
description: 切换页面时淡入 + 轻微上浮的过渡动画；关闭则瞬时切换。
description_en: A fade-in with a slight rise when switching pages; off means instant switching.

name: 成就弹窗
author: AC
description: 解锁成就时在角落弹出提示。默认关闭以免打扰。
description_en: Pops a corner toast when an achievement unlocks. Off by default to stay out of the way.
